_why: Site-only changes. A test override changes only the command or the time allowed (never what is checked). Keyed by exercise id, then the index of the test case. _unavailable lists the exercises that need a 64-bit machine (the machine of the site is 32-bit, so `long` has 4 bytes there): they are shown with a note, Compile and run work, Check says it cannot grade them.

2.cmd: "$BIN" 2>&1 | grep -c -e 'cannot open shared object' -e 'Error loading shared library'

_unavailable.t3-variables-type-sizes: It asks for the sizes of the types on a 64-bit system (long is 8 bytes), and the machine of this site is 32-bit (long is 4).
_unavailable.t3-loops-sum-to-n: Its results need a 64-bit long, and the machine of this site is 32-bit (long is 4 bytes).
_unavailable.t3-stdio-sum-numbers-file: Its results need a 64-bit long, and the machine of this site is 32-bit (long is 4 bytes).

_unavailable.t3-errors-safe-number: It converts numbers up to the largest 64-bit long, and the machine of this site is 32-bit (long is 4 bytes).
_unavailable.t3-functions-is-prime: Its reference needs a 64-bit long to test 2147483647 (the largest int), and the machine of this site is 32-bit (long is 4 bytes).
_unavailable.t3-loops-prime-check: Its reference needs a 64-bit long to test 2147483647 (the largest int), and the machine of this site is 32-bit (long is 4 bytes).
